g.title: EleanorRank6Convo2 begins.
g.text: EleanorRank6Convo2 begins.

g.title: j391479054
g.text: Hey. Need to bounce some ideas off you.

g.title: j1395013669
g.text: Thinking about Fiendsnight. I haven’t dressed up for it for years, but I was leafing through one of Amir’s comics and I suddenly thought - hold on, I could be the Contessa! I’ve got the fangs for it and everything!

g.title: j2684666241
g.text: But is that too obvious? Should I be Dandy Damage?

g.title: j3280330412
g.text: Who's Dandy Damage?

g.title: j2064698042
g.text: You could always dress up as the Lotus, if you wanted to confuse people.

g.title: j2952899645
g.text: … you’re going to have to tell me what Fiendsnight is.

g.title: j1722607579
g.text: Oh mate.

g.title: j1829949696
g.text: Oh Gods no. I've seen her in your head. I could never do her justice.

g.title: j2866878859
g.text: Mmm. I forget you're an innocent abroad, sometimes.

g.title: j2320679999
g.text: Dandy Damage walked so that Temple and the Rippers could run. He was every mother's nightmare and every teenage catastrophe's dream.

g.title: j1659760904
g.text: And that helmet. Is it a helmet? Is it part of her? How does she see through it?

g.title: j3421337652
g.text: Fiendsnight celebrates the fading of Sol's influence on the world.

g.title: j2713814620
g.text: Built like a stick insect, made up like a silent movie queen. Mouth like candy. Pinstripes and leather and dog chain. Cheekbones like a skeleton's hips.

g.title: j2769653900
g.text: Anyway, there's three of her in the one body. I could never pick one of them over the others.

g.title: j3001889547
g.text: Which doesn't make a lot of sense on the face of it. Why celebrate the rising dark? Why rejoice in lawlessness and anarchy?

g.title: j256306218
g.text: Dressing up in costumes? Partying? In a war zone? Do you really think that's going to happen?

g.title: j4098438202
g.text: You know, Fiendsnight sounds a lot like Naberus. People like to dress up for that, too.

g.title: j57396640
g.text: I think it's like an inoculation, maybe. A tiny bit of the thing we fear, to strengthen us. Or maybe it's just an excuse to put on the devil's mask and raise hell.

g.title: j877092588
g.text: ... I'm probably just being silly. Childish. Aren't I?

g.title: j1988335603
g.text: Oh, what am I thinking.

g.title: j2615866033
g.text: I don't need to dress up, do I? I'm already a monster. Forever and ever.

g.title: j2436064064
g.text: Check boolean EleanorDating

g.title: j1960139276
g.text: You're the monster that I love, Eleanor. I don't regret a thing.

g.title: j2436064064->j1960139276
g.text: true

g.title: j4294566504
g.text: I'm starting to think you enjoy saying that about yourself.

g.title: j2436064064->j4294566504
g.text: true

g.title: j2436064064->j4294566504
g.text: false

g.title: j4184479931
g.text: No. Real monsters don't care for people the way that you do.

g.title: j2436064064->j4184479931
g.text: true

g.title: j2436064064->j4184479931
g.text: false

g.title: j4191914052
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3305611303
g.text: If that's what you really believe you are, then Fiendsnight is the perfect chance to celebrate it.

g.title: j4030799483
g.text: I know you're scared of what you might become. But that's not you NOW.

g.title: j2214744657
g.text: Oh yes! Silly me. I forgot the monster got the happy ending in our little story.

g.title: j541772813
g.text: BE the monster. Own it. For this one night of the year, wear that title with pride.

g.title: j1459779272
g.text: So dress up. Have fun. Void knows the Hex could all use some.

g.title: j793607707
g.text: Forgive me. I still can't quite believe that this is what you actually WANT. Maybe I just need a tiny bit more convincing.

g.title: j3588620314
g.text: Oh there are SO MANY reasons why that is a TERRIBLE IDEA

g.title: j928984029
g.text: I'll take you up on that. And thank you. Once again. x

g.title: j3016399151
g.text: Let's devour one another later. xxx

g.title: j1582388056
g.text: SO. MANY.

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j2923882361
g.text: (I can't think of any right now but I'm sure there are DOZENS)

g.title: j404372411
g.text: ... shit.

g.title: j3093381077
g.text: you have skewered me most nimbly upon my own kebab. damn you. well done. x
